summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to explicitly prohibit tax deductions or credits for any business involved in trafficking marijuana, as defined by federal law, or other Schedule I and II controlled substances, if such activities are prohibited by federal or state law.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to explicitly maintain the prohibition on tax deductions and credits for businesses trafficking in marijuana, even if legal under state law. This effectively prevents a tax reduction for these businesses, thus increasing their tax burden relative to if they could claim deductions.
